error.title: Kitsu Login Required
error.description:
## You are not properly logged into Kitsu through AYON
The required Kitsu environment variables are not set or authentication failed, which means you need to authenticate with Kitsu before proceeding with any Kitsu-related operations.
### How to fix this?
**Login to Kitsu using the AYON tray menu:**
1. **Open AYON tray** - Look for the AYON icon in your system tray 2. **Click "Kitsu Connect"** - This will open the Kitsu login dialog 3. **Enter your credentials** - Provide your Kitsu username and password 4. **Click OK** - This will authenticate and set up the required environment variables 5. **Retry your operation** - You will need to restart your application to apply the changes. Once restarted, you can proceed with publishing.
error.detail:
### __Detailed Info__
If you're still having issues after logging in: 1. **Restart AYON** - Close and reopen AYON to refresh environment variables 2. **Check your credentials** - Ensure your Kitsu username and password are correct 3. **Verify server URL** - Make sure the Kitsu server URL is accessible 4. **Contact support** - If problems persist, contact your pipeline team
